title: GTA 6 too blurry? Change this setting
yt_title: GTA 6 too blurry? Change THIS setting 👀
description: Does GTA 6 look blurry to you? Go to Settings > Display > Motion Blur Strength: it runs from 0 to 10 and the default is 3. Set it to 0 to switch it off; blur can even cause motion sickness (Engadget, BGR). On OLED screens, some players reportedly prefer between 4 and 6 so 30 fps looks smoother (player reports via TechRadar). Those console guides promising 60 fps are fake: there's no frame-rate unlock on PS5 or Xbox, and Rockstar targets 30 fps. Is your blur on or off? Comment below.
rumor_note: Rumor (player anecdotes): a motion blur of 4-6 looks smoother on OLED TVs.
